verify.note: This command FAILED, exit 1, and is recorded as a refusal rather than a pass. Every stage through verify:commands was exit 0; the non-zero exit is test:live-db, where assert-staging-target refuses a workstation target by design.

live_api_probe.note: 10 -> 4. Each of the six freed candidates was independently confirmed against live Linear to have an EMPTY incoming blocker set, and each of the four still refused to have a real incomplete incoming blocker. The fix does not simply unblock everything.

direction_evidence.conclusion: The same edge carries type 'blocks' on BOTH ends, so the type string encodes no direction. The connection does: relations is outgoing (downstream), inverseRelations is incoming (prerequisite).

known_limitations: The page size drop to 30 is a real throughput cost: a full board takes an extra round trip and the derived page bound rises to 334. Keeping 50 is not an option -- it is rejected outright.
226.01 per node is a single live measurement from 2026-09-01. A server-side re-pricing by Linear invalidates it and no offline test can detect that.

blocked_by is accepted on both edges but was never observed on either in this team; that branch is reasoned-about, not measured. It is deliberately the fail-closed direction, since accepting it can only add prerequisites.
The regressions use the in-process fake transport and prove the mapping and refusal, not Linear's real cursor semantics. The live probe is the only end-to-end evidence here.
LINEAR_UNREADABLE_RELATIONS_SENTINEL is a string identifier and would collide with an issue literally named UNREADABLE-RELATIONS. No such identifier exists in the UTV2-\d+ scheme.
